question: In September 2023,Skill India Mission introduced a scheme that aims to spread awareness at grass root level about free skill training programmes for youth through robust skill training. What is the name of that scheme ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Skills on Wheels**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Skills on Wheels** scheme was introduced by the **Skill India Mission** in September 2023.
 
• This scheme aims to **spread awareness at the grass root level** about free skill training programmes available for youth.
 
• The initiative focuses on providing **robust skill training** to enhance the employability of young individuals.
 
• It involves using mobile units to reach **remote and underserved areas**, ensuring that more youth can benefit from skill development opportunities.
 
• The **Skill India Mission** is a campaign launched by the **Government of India** to train over 40 crore people in different skills by 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Skills on the Go**__

 __
 
• This term is often used to describe **mobile learning platforms** that allow individuals to learn new skills through apps or online courses while on the move.
 
• However, it is not the name of the scheme introduced by the Skill India Mission in September 2023.
 
 
 
• **Skills on the Move**__
 __
 
• This term could refer to **initiatives or programs** that involve mobile training units, but it is not the specific name of the scheme launched in September 2023.
 
 
 
• **Skill Bus**__
 
 
• A similar concept to Skills on Wheels, where a bus is used as a mobile training unit to deliver skill training to different locations.
 
• However, this is not the correct name for the scheme launched by the Skill India Mission in September 2023.
